name: What types of trim are available for home interiors?

mainEntity.name: What types of trim are available for home interiors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trim, also known as molding, significantly enhances the aesthetic appeal of your home. Common types include baseboards, which cover the joint between walls and floors; crown molding, installed at the junction of walls and ceilings; casing, used around doors and windows; and chair rails, which protect walls from furniture. Materials range from solid wood like pine, oak, and maple, offering natural beauty and durability, to MDF (medium-density fiberboard) or PVC, which are more affordable and moisture-resistant options. Each type serves a distinct decorative and functional purpose.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common trim types include baseboards, crown molding, casing, and chair rails, available in materials like wood, MDF, or PVC.
